verdict.rationale: Data residency is a fair question for a hosted SaaS commerce platform, so the axis applies. Nothing in the evidence documents choosing a storage region. The Multi-Site 'Multiple Brands and Regions' page is about selling to market regions, not where data is stored, so it is adjacent and earns no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can choose where my data is stored (region/residency)
